bugs_found: fx_convert uses assert for missing exchange rates, which can be disabled with Python optimization and then cause a TypeError instead of a controlled error
fx_convert does not validate that exchange rates are positive, allowing negative or zero conversions
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float inputs can raise TypeError and int inputs produce a Receipt with a non-Decimal amount
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), which can produce incorrect financial results
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), which can produce incorrect repayment calculations
